input.title: 50bb · Three-heart river
input.description: A 12bb river pot on Kh Jh 8h 3c 2d. BB acts first with 44bb behind. Exact suits matter: half-pot, pot, all-in, and one subsequent raise are modeled.
input.rangeAssumptions: Illustrative study ranges, not inferred or certified preflop ranges. Equal starting weight per unblocked exact combination, not equal weight per hand class. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
